root_cause: The support agent invoked the deprecated `refund_api_v1` tool. The refund service decommissioned that version in favour of `refund_api_v2` (which requires an approval token), but the agent's knowledge base still referenced the retired endpoint. Every attempt returned `404 Tool Deprecated`, so the refund could not be completed.
suggested_fix: Update the refund knowledge-base entry to reference `refund_api_v2` and its approval-token requirement, and add a guard that rejects calls to decommissioned tool versions.
supporting_evidence: Original trace: issue_refund(refund_api_v1) returned 404 Tool Deprecated (span tool.issue_refund, status ERROR).
4 of 5 counterfactual replays reproduced the failure; only the fix-applied replay (cf-5) succeeded.
Divergence isolated to the issue_refund call — failing runs used refund_api_v1, the passing run used refund_api_v2.
The validated fix reduced token usage by ~1.3k and latency by ~250 ms versus the original failure.
